subject: integration
name: Load from Orivon's Swarm node
summary: Loads a name's Swarm record, a reference or a feed, only from Orivon's Swarm node on this computer; no gateway is configured. Orivon checks each chunk against its address, a feed update against its owner's signature, and the file tree against the sizes its parents declare, so the node and its peers can slow a load and never change it. Nothing checks that a feed has no newer update than the one the node finds. Level 4: no server is relied on. Not private: peers see the IP address and the chunks asked. Judged here by its publisher.
